units.source_text: 我变换着各种角度或恻头眺望。

en.t: I looked at it from various angles, sometimes tilting my head.

units.source_text: 它已经引不起我任何的感动。

en.t: It no longer stirred any feeling in me at all.

units.source_text: 它只不过是一幢古老的黑乎乎的三层小建筑物。

en.t: It was nothing more than an old, dark, three-story little building.

units.source_text: 顶尖上的凤凰，也像只乌鸦似的。

en.t: Even the phoenix on the top looked like a crow.

units.source_text: 岂止不美，甚至给人一种不调和、不稳定的感觉。

en.t: It was not merely unbeautiful; it even gave an impression of disharmony and instability.

units.source_text: 我寻思：所谓美，难道党是这样不美的东西吗？

en.t: I wondered: could what people call beauty really be something this unbeautiful?
